text_block_list.text:
The day of the 'Japan Cup', the grand 
stage of the autumn season, had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, what do you think, Trainer? Does 
this outfit look good on me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"After all, this is the grand stage for 
me, having grown one, no, two steps 
bigger!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them how far I've climbed, after 
all the hard work I put in!
choice_data_list:
Your heart's gotten stronger too, hasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Trainer, you feel even more 
reliable than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off! I'll hit 'em with 
everything I've got right now!
